en.title: 4.5 magnitude earthquake strikes Gulf of Eilat, triggers alerts and airport closure
en.dek: A 4.5 magnitude earthquake hit the Gulf of Eilat on 11 November 2026, triggering alerts and temporarily shutting Ramon Airport.
facts: A magnitude 4.5 earthquake triggered alerts in Eilat and surrounding areas
The quake was the first-ever warning alert in the region
Ramon Airport was temporarily grounded following the earthquake
The Jerusalem Post reported no injuries from the quake
Anadolu Ajansı confirmed the quake hit the Gulf of Eilat
Evacuations were triggered in Eilat following the earthquake
body: On 11 November 2026 at 10:12 UTC, a magnitude 4.5 earthquake triggered alerts in Eilat and surrounding areas, according to Haaretz. Israel National News stated this was the first-ever warning alert for a quake measuring 4.5 in the region.

Later that day at 13:17 UTC, The Jerusalem Post reported the earthquake had temporarily grounded flights at Ramon Airport. The Media Line confirmed the quake triggered evacuations in Eilat and shut the airport temporarily.
Anadolu Ajansı reported the 4.5 magnitude earthquake hit the Gulf of Eilat. The Jerusalem Post stated the quake had no reported injuries.
Israel National News noted the earthquake measured 4.5 and was the first-ever warning alert, while Haaretz confirmed it triggered alerts in Eilat and surrounding areas.
The Media Line reported evacuations in Eilat and the temporary shutdown of Ramon Airport following the quake.
The Jerusalem Post and Anadolu Ajansı both confirmed the magnitude was 4.5 with no reported injuries.
Haaretz and Israel National News both confirmed the magnitude was 4.5 and that alerts were triggered in Eilat and surrounding areas.
The Media Line confirmed evacuations and airport closure, while The Jerusalem Post confirmed no injuries were reported.
Anadolu Ajansı confirmed the quake hit the Gulf of Eilat, and The Jerusalem Post confirmed the magnitude and lack of injuries.
en.context: On 11 November 2026, a 4.5 magnitude earthquake affected the Eilat region, triggering alerts and temporarily disrupting air travel at Ramon Airport. Sources including Haaretz, Israel National News, The Jerusalem Post, The Media Line, and Anadolu Ajansı reported on the event's impact and magnitude.

en.headline: 4.5 magnitude earthquake hits Gulf of Eilat
en.body: According to Anadolu Ajansı, a 4.5 magnitude earthquake hit the Gulf of Eilat. The Jerusalem Post reports the quake had no reported injuries.

es.headline: Terremoto de 4,5 grados golpea el Golfo de Eilat
es.body: Según Anadolu Ajansı, un terremoto de magnitud 4,5 golpeó el Golfo de Eilat. El Jerusalem Post informa que no hubo heridos reportados.

de.headline: Erdbeben der Stärke 4,5 im Golf von Eilat
de.body: Laut Anadolu Ajansı hat ein Erdbeben der Stärke 4,5 den Golf von Eilat getroffen. Die Jerusalem Post berichtet, dass es keine gemeldeten Verletzten gab.

it.headline: Terremoto di magnitudo 4.5 colpisce il Golfo di Eilat
it.body: Secondo Anadolu Ajansı, un terremoto di magnitudo 4.5 ha colpito il Golfo di Eilat. Il Jerusalem Post riferisce che il sisma non ha provocato feriti segnalati.

pt.headline: Terremoto de magnitude 4,5 atinge Golfo de Eilat
pt.body: Segundo a Anadolu Ajansı, um terremoto de magnitude 4,5 atingiu o Golfo de Eilat. O Jerusalem Post refere que o sismo não provocou ferimentos reportados.

fr.headline: Un séisme de magnitude 4,5 frappe le Golfe d'Eilat
fr.body: Selon Anadolu Ajansı, un séisme de magnitude 4,5 a frappé le Golfe d'Eilat. Le Jerusalem Post rapporte qu'il n'y a pas eu de blessés signalés.

zh.headline: 埃拉特湾发生4.5级地震
zh.body: 据阿纳多卢通讯社报道，埃拉特湾发生4.5级地震。《耶路撒冷邮报》报道称，此次地震暂无人员受伤报告。

ko.headline: 에일라트 만에서 규모 4.5 지진 발생
ko.body: 아나돌루 통신사에 따르면 에일라트 만에서 규모 4.5의 지진이 발생했다. 예루살렘 포스트는 이 지진으로 인한 부상자는 보고되지 않았다고 전했다.

ja.headline: マグニチュード4.5の地震がエイラート湾を襲う
ja.body: アナドル通信によれば、マグニチュード4.5の地震がエイラート湾を襲った。エルサレム・ポストは、この地震による負傷者の報告はないと伝えている。

sources.title: Eilat, southern Israel hit by 4.5 magnitude earthquake, no injuries reported
Magnitude 4.5 Earthquake Triggers Evacuations in Eilat, Shuts Ramon Airport Temporarily

en.headline: Ramon Airport temporarily grounds flights
en.body: The Jerusalem Post reports the earthquake temporarily grounded flights at Ramon Airport. The Media Line states the quake triggered evacuations in Eilat and shut the airport temporarily.

es.headline: El aeropuerto Ramón suspende temporalmente vuelos
es.body: El Jerusalem Post informa que el terremoto suspendió temporalmente los vuelos en el aeropuerto Ramón. The Media Line indica que el sismo provocó evacuaciones en Eilat y cerró temporalmente el aeropuerto.

de.headline: Flughafen Ramon vorübergehend geschlossen
de.body: Die Jerusalem Post berichtet, dass das Erdbeben vorübergehend Flüge am Flughafen Ramon zum Erliegen brachte. The Media Line zufolge wurden Evakuierungen in Eilat ausgelöst und der Flughafen vorübergehend geschlossen.

it.headline: L'aeroporto Ramon sospende temporaneamente i voli
it.body: Il Jerusalem Post riferisce che il terremoto ha temporaneamente interrotto i voli all'aeroporto Ramon. Il Media Line afferma che il sisma ha attivato le evacuazioni ad Eilat e chiuso temporaneamente l'aeroporto.

pt.headline: Aeroporto de Ramon suspende temporariamente voos
pt.body: O Jerusalem Post refere que o terremoto suspendeu temporariamente os voos no Aeroporto de Ramon. A The Media Line indica que o abalo sísmico provocou evacuações em Eilat e fechou temporariamente o aeroporto.

fr.headline: L'aéroport Ramon suspend temporairement ses vols
fr.body: Le Jerusalem Post rapporte que le séisme a temporairement interrompu les vols à l'aéroport Ramon. The Media Line indique que le séisme a déclenché des évacuations à Eilat et a fermé temporairement l'aéroport.

zh.headline: 拉蒙机场航班暂时停飞
zh.body: 《耶路撒冷邮报》报道，地震导致拉蒙机场航班暂时停飞。The Media Line称，地震引发埃拉特人员疏散，并导致机场暂时关闭。

ko.headline: 라몬 공항, 항공편 일시 운항 중단
ko.body: 예루살렘 포스트는 지진으로 라몬 공항의 항공편 운항이 일시적으로 중단됐다고 보도했다. 더 미디어 라인은 이번 지진이 에일라트에서 대피를 유발했고 공항을 일시적으로 폐쇄시켰다고 전했다.

ja.headline: ラモン空港が一時的にフライトを停止
ja.body: エルサレム・ポストによると、この地震でラモン空港は一時的にフライトを停止した。ザ・メディア・ラインは、地震がエイラートで避難を引き起こし、空港を一時閉鎖したと述べた。

en.headline: 4.5 magnitude earthquake triggers alerts in Eilat
en.body: Haaretz reports a magnitude 4.5 earthquake triggered alerts in Eilat and surrounding areas. Israel National News states the quake measured 4.5 and was the first-ever warning alert.

es.headline: Terremoto de 4,5 grados activa alertas en Eilat
es.body: Haaretz informa que un terremoto de magnitud 4,5 activó alertas en Eilat y sus alrededores. Israel National News señala que el sismo midió 4,5 y fue la primera alerta de advertencia jamás registrada.

de.headline: Erdbeben der Stärke 4,5 löst Warnungen in Eilat aus
de.body: Haaretz berichtet von einem Erdbeben der Stärke 4,5, das Warnungen in Eilat und Umgebung auslöste. Israel National News zufolge betrug die Stärke des Erdbebens 4,5 und es handelte sich um die allererste Warnmeldung.

it.headline: Terremoto di magnitudo 4.5 attiva allarmi ad Eilat
it.body: Haaretz riporta che un terremoto di magnitudo 4.5 ha attivato allarmi ad Eilat e nelle aree circostanti. Israel National News afferma che il sisma ha registrato una magnitudo di 4.5 ed è stato il primo avviso mai emesso.

pt.headline: Terremoto de magnitude 4,5 desencadeia alertas em Eilat
pt.body: O Haaretz refere que um terremoto de magnitude 4,5 desencadeou alertas em Eilat e áreas circundantes. O Israel National News afirma que o abalo mediu 4,5 e foi o primeiro alerta de aviso alguma vez registado.

fr.headline: Un séisme de magnitude 4,5 déclenche des alertes à Eilat
fr.body: Haaretz rapporte qu'un séisme de magnitude 4,5 a déclenché des alertes à Eilat et dans les environs. Israel National News indique que le séisme mesurait 4,5 et constituait la première alerte jamais émise.

zh.headline: 4.5级地震在埃拉特触发警报
zh.body: 据《国土报》报道，4.5级地震在埃拉特及周边地区触发警报。Israel National News称，此次地震震级为4.5级，系史上首个预警警报。

ko.headline: 에일라트에 규모 4.5 지진 경보 발령
ko.body: 하아레츠는 규모 4.5의 지진으로 에일라트와 인근 지역에 경보가 발령됐다고 보도했다. 이스라엘 내셔널 뉴스는 지진의 규모가 4.5였으며 이는 사상 최초의 경보였다고 전했다.

ja.headline: マグニチュード4.5の地震がエイラートで警報を発令
ja.body: ハアレツによると、マグニチュード4.5の地震がエイラートと周辺地域に警報を発令した。イスラエル・ナショナル・ニュースは、この地震はマグニチュード4.5を観測し、史上初めての警報だったと述べた。
